d:
Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ko lekar pure desh ke sath-sath videshon men harsh aur utsah dekha ja raha hai. isi kram men aitihasik barganv dham bhi chhath ke rang men ranga najar aa raha hai. aisi manyata hai ki bhagvan bhaskar ko arghy dene ki paranpra dvapar kal men isi barganv dham se shuru huee thi, jo aaj pure desh men mahaparv ke rup men manaee jati hai.
